stem: A client has fatigue, hypotension, salt craving, and patchy hyperpigmentation. Which endocrine disorder best fits this pattern?
rationale: Endocrine Society guidance identifies volume depletion/hypotension and hyperpigmentation as clinical features that should prompt evaluation for primary adrenal insufficiency; salt craving is also a characteristic symptom of mineralocorticoid deficiency in primary disease. Therefore B is correct. Cushing syndrome reflects glucocorticoid excess, acromegaly reflects growth-hormone excess, and primary hyperaldosteronism is associated with aldosterone excess rather than this salt-craving/hypotensive pattern.
educational_objective: Recognize the characteristic clinical pattern of primary adrenal insufficiency.
source_version_date: Current Endocrine Society guideline resource as accessed 2026-08-16
source_locator: Summary Recommendation 1.1 — hypotension/volume depletion and hyperpigmentation among signs suggesting PAI; mineralocorticoid monitoring/patient guidance — salt craving and postural hypotension.
source_claim_supported: Primary adrenal insufficiency can present with fatigue/weakness, hypotension, salt craving and hyperpigmentation.

source_original.stem: A client has fatigue, hypotension, salt craving, and patchy hyperpigmentation. Which endocrine disorder best fits this pattern?
source_original.rationale: Primary adrenal insufficiency can produce fatigue or weakness, hypotension from volume depletion, salt craving from mineralocorticoid deficiency, and hyperpigmentation associated with elevated ACTH, so Option B is correct. Cushing syndrome reflects glucocorticoid excess, acromegaly reflects growth-hormone excess, and primary hyperaldosteronism typically produces hypertension rather than this pattern.
source_original.source_detail: Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline — Primary Adrenal Insufficiency, clinical features and diagnostic considerations: glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid deficiency can cause fatigue or weakness, volume depletion and hypotension, salt craving, and hyperpigmentation from elevated ACTH in primary disease. Endocrine Society Primary Adrenal Insufficiency guideline remains the current society guideline resource; live source and current status rechecked 2026-08-15.
